reason: Reviewed Grok native lifecycle, question routing, setup, CLI readiness and domain terms. The Grok guide describes tool-result activation, child Stop gates, long-answer retrieval, Cursor import recovery and conditional shared-leader Notes and Answer Edits. Preserved current main: distinct acknowledged answers can continue a conversation without an aggregate cap, per-answer retry and acknowledgement guards remain, and ask describes background submission as scheduled rather than confirmed. Preserved Android Play onboarding and native-answer settlement guidance; domain terms are unchanged. Doctor now describes held-Stop answers and conditional shared-leader messages separately and reports the active Grok attendant. Grok shared-leader answers now use claimed interjection, avoiding the native eight-blocking-continuation limit; the guide recommends leader mode for ongoing conversations and states the ordinary-session limit explicitly. Re-reviewed late-answer recovery: Grok prompt hooks leave collection and close selection to Stop because their stdout cannot deliver context; cancellation retains the original question and its claimed delivery. Re-reviewed claimed batches: every Grok answer in an interjection must have its own claim; refused or unselected members retain the complete batch without a write.
